[[Image:Toki pona.svg|thumb|right]]A naturalistic language with simplified grammar and lexicon. Has around ~150 words only. Created by Sonja Elen Kisa in 2001.
Here are some examples of Lojban and toki pona sentences.
<tab class=wikitable>
sina	tawa	ala	tawa		
'''do''' 	'''klama'''	'''ji'''	'''klama'''		
					
mi	moku	e	kili		
'''mi'''	'''citka'''	'''fe lo'''	'''grute'''		
					
sina	wile		pali	e	seme
'''do'''	'''djica'''	'''lo ka'''	'''zukte'''	'''fe lo'''	'''mo'''
</tab>
